NOTE
**Still not ready — the description still doesn't follow the PR template**

New: The author squashed the work into one commit and rewrote the description with "Fixes #19589", a testing section and a checklist. Missing: the checklist isn't the one from Zulip's PR template, and the description still has broken formatting (stray backslashes around field names). It also doesn't mention open PR #38098 for the same issue, which is already in review.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and have laurynmm, who gave the feedback, follow up if the author doesn't fix this.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! Please use the self-review checklist from the [PR template](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html), fix the description formatting, and explain how this compares to the open PR #38098 for the same issue.
```
